## Checklist

- [ ] The file is `cards/<slug>.json` (research system) or `tools/<slug>.json` (installable tool), and `slug` equals the file name.
- [ ] `make check` passes locally (or `python3 scripts/check.py`).
- [ ] Every number in `headline_result` appears in a linked primary source.
- [ ] `caveat` (cards) or `not_proved` (tools) says what the work does not prove.
- [ ] New cards use `"verification": {"status": "submitted", ...}`. Maintainers set it to `verified` after checking the sources.
- [ ] I agree that this contribution is published under CC BY 4.0.
